data.title: Using firm-level supply chain networks to measure the speed of the energy transition
data.author: Johannes Stangl, András Borsos, Stefan Thurner
data.summary: Abstract International climate targets rely on the success of the energy transition, however systematic monitoring on how the economy adopts low-carbon energy remains underdeveloped. Here we use nationwide supply-chain network data to reconstruct energy portfolios for 25,000 Hungarian firms between 2020 and 2024, covering 75% of gas, 70% of electricity, and 50% of oil consumption. This allows us to quantify the speed of the energy transition -the transition towards low-carbon electricity- on the firm level. We find substantial heterogeneity in decarbonization progress: half of firms increase low-carbon energy shares, but 50% reduce it. Energy cost structures are closely associated with transition behavior, indicating technology-related lock-in effects. Extrapolating current trends yields an aggregate low-carbon share of 20% by 2050, highlighting ineffective decarbonization efforts. If firms strictly adopted strategies of decarbonization frontrunners within their industry sectors, a low-carbon share of 70% could be achieved by 2050, putting climate targets within reach.
data.title_cn: 使用企业级供应链网络来衡量能源转型的速度
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 国际气候目标依赖于能源转型的成功，但对经济如何采用低碳能源的系统监测仍然不发达。在这里，我们利用全国供应链网络数据重建了 2020 年至 2024 年间 25,000 家匈牙利企业的能源组合，涵盖 75% 的天然气、70% 的电力和 50% 的石油消费。这使我们能够在企业层面量化能源转型（向低碳电力转型）的速度。我们发现脱碳进程存在显着的异质性：一半的企业增加了低碳能源份额，但 50% 的企业减少了低碳能源份额。能源成本结构与转型行为密切相关，表明与技术相关的锁定效应。推断当前趋势，到 2050 年，低碳份额将达到 20%，这凸显了脱碳努力的无效性。如果企业严格采取行业内的脱碳领跑者战略，到2050年低碳份额可以达到70%，气候目标触手可及。

data.title: Cellulose nanofibers and limestone filler enable high-performance, sustainable, and cost-efficient printable concrete
data.author: Yu Wang, Ala Eddin Douba, Naveenkumar Rajendiran, David L. Cubillos-Gamez, Akshat Verma, Richard D. Bergman, Troy Runge, Jan Olek, Pablo D. Zavattieri, Jeffrey P. Youngblood
data.summary: The study develops a printable concrete using cellulose nanofibers and limestone filler, enhancing rheological and mechanical properties while reducing cement content. It demonstrates improved buildability and sustainability, with potential for large-scale 3D printing applications in construction.
data.title_cn: 纤维素纳米纤维和石灰石填料可实现高性能、可持续且经济高效的可打印混凝土
data.abstract_cn: 该研究开发了一种使用纤维素纳米纤维和石灰石填料的可打印混凝土，在降低水泥含量的同时增强流变学和机械性能。它展示了改进的可建造性和可持续性，具有在建筑中大规模 3D 打印应用的潜力。

data.title: Continuously trapped matter-wave interferometry in magic Floquet-Bloch band structures
data.author: Xiao Chai, Eber Nolasco-Martinez, Xuanwei Liang, Jeremy L. Tanlimco, E. Quinn Simmons, Eric Zhu, Roshan Sajjad, Hector Mas, S. Nicole Halawani, Alec Cao, David M. Weld
data.summary: Abstract Trapped matter-wave interferometry offers the promise of compact high-precision local force sensing. However, noise in the trap itself can introduce new systematic errors which are absent in traditional free-fall interferometers. We describe and demonstrate an intrinsically noise-tolerant Floquet-engineered platform for continuously trapped atom interferometry. A non-interacting degenerate quantum gas undergoes position-space Bloch oscillations through an amplitude-modulated optical lattice, whose resulting Floquet-Bloch band structure includes Landau-Zener beamsplitters and Bragg mirrors, forming the components of a Mach-Zehnder interferometric force sensor. We identify, realize, and experimentally characterize magic band structures, analogous to the magic wavelengths employed in optical lattice clocks, for which the interferometric phase is insensitive to lattice intensity noise. We leverage the intrinsic programmability of the Floquet band synthesis approach to demonstrate a variety of interferometer structures, highlighting the potential of this technique for quantum force sensors which are tunable, compact, simple, and robust.
data.title_cn: 神奇的 Floquet-Bloch 带结构中的连续俘获物质波干涉测量
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 俘获物质波干涉测量技术为紧凑型高精度局部力传感提供了前景。然而，陷阱本身的噪声可能会引入传统自由落体干涉仪中不存在的新系统误差。我们描述并演示了一个本质上耐噪声的 Floquet 设计平台，用于连续捕获原子干涉测量。非相互作用的简并量子气体通过调幅光学晶格经历位置空间布洛赫振荡，其产生的弗洛奎特-布洛赫能带结构包括朗道-齐纳分束器和布拉格镜，形成马赫-曾德干涉力传感器的组件。我们识别、实现并通过实验表征魔能带结构，类似于光学晶格时钟中使用的魔能波长，其中干涉相位对晶格强度噪声不敏感。我们利用 Floquet 能带合成方法的固有可编程性来演示各种干涉仪结构，突出了该技术对于可调谐、紧凑、简单且坚固的量子力传感器的潜力。

data.title: Homogeneous integration of two-dimensional material-based optoelectronic neurons and ferroelectric synapses for neuromorphic vision
data.author: Jiarong Wang, Keqin Liu, Pek Jun Tiw, Dawei He, Lianfeng Yu, Bowen Wang, Jinxuan Bai, Teng Zhang, Xin Shan, Yang Yang, Yuzhe Wang, Yongsheng Wang, Yaoyu Tao, Xiaoxian Zhang, Yuchao Yang
data.summary: Integrating volatile optical sensing with non-volatile memory is crucial for neuromorphic vision applications. Wang et al. propose a homogeneous integration scheme that combines optoelectronic neurons and ferroelectric synapses on a single substrate for color recognition and object detection tasks.
data.title_cn: 基于二维材料的光电神经元和铁电突触的均匀集成，用于神经形态视觉
data.abstract_cn: 将易失性光学传感与非易失性存储器集成对于神经形态视觉应用至关重要。王等人。提出了一种同质集成方案，将光电神经元和铁电突触结合在单个基板上，用于颜色识别和物体检测任务。

data.title: Explainable AI-based analysis of human pancreas sections identifies traits of type 2 diabetes
data.author: Lukas Klein, Sebastian Ziegler, Felicia Gerst, Yanni Morgenroth, Karol Gotkowski, Eyke Schöniger, Martin Heni, Nicole Kipke, Daniela Friedland, Annika Seiler, Ellen Geibelt, Hajime Yamazaki, Hans-Ulrich Häring, Silvia Wagner, Silvio Nadalin, Alfred Königsrainer, Andre L. Mihaljevic, Daniel Hartmann, Falko Fend, Daniela Aust, Jürgen Weitz, Reiner Jumpertz-von Schwartzenberg, Marius Distler, Klaus Maier-Hein, Andreas L. Birkenfeld, Susanne Ullrich, Paul F. Jäger, Fabian Isensee, Michele Solimena, Robert Wagner
data.summary: Abstract Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is a chronic disease currently affecting around 500 million people worldwide with often severe health consequences. Yet, histopathological analyses are still inadequate to infer the glycaemic state of a person based on morphological alterations linked to impaired insulin secretion and β -cell failure in T2D. Giga-pixel microscopy can capture subtle morphological changes, but data complexity exceeds human analysis capabilities. In response, we generate a dataset of pancreas whole-slide images from living donors with multiple chromogenic and multiplex immunofluorescence stainings and train deep learning models to predict the T2D status. Using explainable AI, we make the learned relationships interpretable, quantify them as biomarkers, and assess their association with T2D. Remarkably, the highest prediction performance is achieved by simultaneously focusing on islet α - and δ -cells and neuronal axons, alongside subtle pancreatic alterations in T2D donors such as larger adipocyte clusters, altered islet-adipocyte proximity and smaller islets. This data-driven approach provides a foundation for future research into relevant diagnostic and therapeutic targets, refining several hypotheses regarding tissue alterations associated with T2D.
data.title_cn: 基于可解释的人工智能的人类胰腺切片分析确定了 2 型糖尿病的特征
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 2 型糖尿病 (T2D) 是一种慢性疾病，目前影响着全球约 5 亿人，通常会造成严重的健康后果。然而，组织病理学分析仍然不足以根据与 T2D 胰岛素分泌受损和 β 细胞衰竭相关的形态学改变来推断一个人的血糖状态。千兆像素显微镜可以捕捉细微的形态变化，但数据复杂性超出了人类的分析能力。作为回应，我们生成了来自活体捐赠者的胰腺全切片图像的数据集，具有多种显色和多重免疫荧光染色，并训练深度学习模型来预测 T2D 状态。使用可解释的人工智能，我们可以解释学到的关系，将它们量化为生物标志物，并评估它们与 T2D 的关联。值得注意的是，通过同时关注胰岛 α 和 δ 细胞以及神经元轴突，以及 T2D 供体中微妙的胰腺变化（例如较大的脂肪细胞簇、改变的胰岛-脂肪细胞接近度和较小的胰岛），可以实现最高的预测性能。这种数据驱动的方法为未来相关诊断和治疗靶点的研究奠定了基础，完善了与 T2D 相关的组织改变的几种假设。

data.title: Tailoring sodium and oxygen mixed-ion conduction in the A-site non-stoichiometric NaNbO3-based ceramics
data.author: Zhiyong Liu, Chenggong Xiang, Pengrong Ren, Kun Guo, Bing Xie, Pu Mao, Haijun Sun, Huiqing Fan
data.summary: Abstract Tailoring the electronic or ionic conduction properties of solid-state electrolytes with precision is essential to fulfilling the functional demands of electrochemical energy storage and conversion technologies. Here, the synergistic regulation of Na + and O 2− ions conduction in the Na 0.96 x Ca 0.04 Nb 0.96 Zr 0.04 O 3- δ conductor is achieved by the non-stoichiometric ratio strategy. Crystal structure and electrical property analyses reveal that all samples feature a Pbma orthorhombic structure. With rising Na content, the defect characteristics shift from vacancies to interstitials, the NbO 6 octahedra experience a change from being compressed to normal and then to being obliquely flattened, which leads to an expansion of the corresponding interstitials in the Na-O-Na and Na-O-Nb networks. By changing the structures of these three types of polyhedron and networks, the conduction channels of Na + and O 2− ions as well as electrons can be effectively regulated. The O 2− ions are the main charge carriers for Na-deficient samples, stoichiometric samples feature the mixed O 2− ions and intrinsic electrons, while Na⁺ ions become the dominant carriers for Na-excess samples. This work highlights the important role of lattice defects and oxygen octahedral distortions/twisting on the conductivity, offering insights into the design of and Na + /O 2− ions migration pathways in solid-state ion conductors.
data.title_cn: A 位非化学计量 NaNbO3 基陶瓷中钠氧混合离子传导的调控
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 精确定制固态电解质的电子或离子传导特性对于满足电化学储能和转换技术的功能需求至关重要。这里，Na 0.96 x Ca 0.04 Nb 0.96 Zr 0.04 O 3- δ 导体中Na + 和O 2− 离子传导的协同调节是通过非化学计量比策略实现的。晶体结构和电学性质分析表明所有样品均具有 Pbma 斜方结构。随着Na含量的增加，缺陷特征从空位转变为填隙，NbO 6 八面体经历了从压缩到正常再到倾斜扁平的变化，导致Na-O-Na和Na-O-Nb网络中相应填隙的扩展。通过改变这三种多面体和网络的结构，可以有效调控Na + 和O 2− 离子以及电子的传导通道。 O 2− 离子是Na 缺乏样品的主要载流子，化学计量样品具有混合的O 2− 离子和本征电子，而Na⁺ 离子成为Na 过量样品的主要载流子。这项工作强调了晶格缺陷和氧八面体扭曲/扭曲对电导率的重要作用，为固态离子导体中Na + /O 2− 离子迁移路径的设计提供了见解。

data.title: Assessment of self-management empowerment program on sense of coherence, self-‌efficacy and postpartum anxiety in cesarean mothers randomized trial
data.author: Fariba Najafi ShahaliBegloo, Farahnaz Kamali, Sudabeh Mohamadi, Maryam Ravanipour
data.summary: Conflicting study outcomes on women undergoing cesarean sections underscore the complex relationship between repeated cesarean deliveries and factors such as sense of coherence, self-efficacy, and anxiety, highlighting the need for empowerment-based interventions to improve mothers’ mental health and parenting outcomes. This randomized controlled trial aimed to evaluate an educational program based on the self-management empowerment model on sense of coherence, self-efficacy, and postpartum anxiety in cesarean mothers. In 2024, 98 women scheduled for cesarean delivery at Shohada-ye-Khalij-e-Fars Hospital, Bushehr, Iran, were selected by convenience sampling and randomly assigned via block randomization to intervention (n = 49) or control (n = 49) groups. The intervention group received a five-step education program over two months. Antonovsky’s Sense of Coherence Questionnaire, Sherer’s Self-Efficacy Scale, and Spielberger Anxiety Questionnaire were administered pre- and post-intervention. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27 with descriptive/inferential statistics (p < 0.05). Mean changes showed significant intervention effects: self-efficacy − 1.58 ± 7.31 (control) versus 2.79 ± 6.42 (intervention, ŋ2 = 0.151, p < 0.001); sense of coherence 2.67 ± 8.36 (control) versus 4.81 ± 6.58 (intervention, ŋ2 = 0.073, p = 0.018); anxiety 0.02 ± 15.99 (control) versus − 13.07 ± 13.7 (intervention, ŋ2 = 0.224, p < 0.001). The self-management empowerment model significantly improved sense of coherence and self-efficacy while reducing postpartum anxiety, recommending its integration into postpartum care programs. Trial Registration http://www.irct.ir/, IRCTID: IRCT20130422013092N12 registered July 11, 2024.
data.title_cn: 自我管理赋权计划对剖腹产母亲一致性感、自我效能感和产后焦虑的评估随机试验
data.abstract_cn: 关于接受剖腹产的妇女的相互矛盾的研究结果强调了重复剖腹产与连贯感、自我效能感和焦虑等因素之间的复杂关系，强调需要基于赋权的干预措施来改善母亲的心理健康和养育结果。这项随机对照试验旨在评估基于自我管理赋权模型的教育计划对剖腹产母亲的连贯感、自我效能感和产后焦虑的影响。 2024 年，通过方便抽样选出了 98 名计划在伊朗布什尔 Shohada-ye-Khalij-e-Fars 医院剖腹产的妇女，并通过分块随机化随机分配到干预组 (n = 49) 或对照组 (n = 49)。干预组接受了为期两个月的五步教育计划。在干预前后进行安东诺夫斯基一致性感问卷、谢勒自我效能感量表和斯皮尔伯格焦虑问卷。使用 SPSS 27 版进行数据分析，并进行描述性/推论性统计 (p < 0.05)。平均变化显示出显着的干预效果：自我效能 - 1.58 ± 7.31（对照）与 2.79 ± 6.42（干预，ŋ2 = 0.151，p < 0.001）；连贯感 2.67 ± 8.36（对照）对比 4.81 ± 6.58（干预，ŋ2 = 0.073，p = 0.018）；焦虑 0.02 ± 15.99（对照）对比 − 13.07 ± 13.7（干预，ŋ2 = 0.224，p < 0.001）。自我管理赋权模式显着提高了连贯感和自我效能感，同时减少了产后焦虑，建议将其纳入产后护理计划。试用注册http://www.irct.ir/，IRCTID：IRCT20130422013092N12，注册于2024年7月11日。

data.title: Bending behavior of concrete-filled FRP wound tubular arches with internal FRP bars
data.author: Benben Li, Zhenyuan Yang, Yujun Qi, Zhenglong Zhou, Guowei Wang
data.summary: Conventional reinforced concrete arches are susceptible to corrosion in underground environments, leading to reduced durability. This study proposes concrete-filled FRP (Fiber-reinforced polymer) wound tubular arches with internal FRP bars to achieve excellent corrosion resistance. Eighteen concrete-filled FRP tubular arches were tested under mid-span concentrated loading, and the effects of FRP tube wall thickness and FRP reinforcement configuration were investigated. The experimental results demonstrate that increasing the wall thickness of the FRP tube significantly enhances the ultimate load-bearing capacity, with a maximum increase of 104.7% observed under mid-span loading. The incorporation of FRP reinforcement also resulted in 236.3%~279% increase of ultimate capacity and 111.11%-119.67% increase of displacement ductility ratio. A simplified theoretical model for predicting the ultimate load of concrete-filled FRP tubular arches with internal FRP bars was proposed, achieving a relative error within 10%. The proposed concrete-filled FRP tubular arch demonstrates considerable potential for application in underground engineering.
data.title_cn: 内置FRP筋的FRP混凝土缠绕管拱的弯曲性能
data.abstract_cn: 传统的钢筋混凝土拱门在地下环境中容易受到腐蚀，导致耐久性降低。本研究提出采用混凝土填充 FRP（纤维增强聚合物）缠绕管拱，内部带有 FRP 筋，以实现优异的耐腐蚀性。对18个FRP管混凝土拱进行跨中集中荷载试验，研究FRP管壁厚和FRP筋配置的影响。实验结果表明，增加FRP管的壁厚显着提高了极限承载能力，在跨中荷载下最大增加了104.7%。 FRP加固的加入还导致极限承载力增加236.3%~279%，位移延性比增加111.11%-119.67%。提出了一种预测内置FRP筋的FRP管混凝土拱极限荷载的简化理论模型，相对误差在10%以内。所提出的混凝土填充玻璃钢管拱在地下工程中显示出巨大的应用潜力。

data.title: Thermoregulatory adaptations to cold in C3H/HeJ mice are independent of ADRB3 signaling
data.author: Sarra Beji, Mathilde Mouchiroud, Yves Gélinas, Mathieu Laplante, Andréanne Michaud, Alexandre Caron
data.summary: Abstract Housing conditions and mouse strain significantly influence metabolic phenotypes, affecting the translational relevance of preclinical studies. Although C57BL/6J (C57) mice are widely used, their thermogenic and adrenergic profiles may not fully reflect human physiology. This study compared thermogenic responses to cold exposure between male C57 and C3H/HeJ (C3H) mice. Animals were housed in a Promethion indirect calorimetry system and exposed to varying ambient temperatures. Thermoneutral points during the light phase were nearly identical (C57: 29.26 ± 0.28 °C; C3H: 29.46 ± 0.17 °C), yet C3H mice exhibited significantly higher energy expenditure (EE) during both acute and chronic cold exposure. Gene expression analysis revealed a stronger induction of thermogenic genes in brown adipose tissue (BAT) of C3H mice. Notably, β3-adrenergic receptor ( Adrb3 ) expression was minimal in BAT and white adipose tissue (WAT) of C3H mice and unaffected by cold exposure. Consistent with impaired β3 signaling, the β3 agonist CL 316,243 markedly increased EE in C57 mice but had only modest effects in C3H mice. In contrast, norepinephrine elicited EE responses in both strains, and propranolol pretreatment (a β1/β2 antagonist) abolished these strain differences, suggesting that C3H mice depend on β1/β2 or non-canonical pathways. In conclusion, C3H mice exhibit enhanced cold-induced thermogenesis through ADRB3-independent mechanisms. Despite similar thermoneutral point, C3H and C57 mice display distinct metabolic and adrenergic adaptations, underscoring the importance of strain selection in metabolic research. C3H mice may represent a model to study alternative thermogenic mechanisms applicable to human physiology.
data.title_cn: C3H/HeJ 小鼠对寒冷的温度调节适应与 ADRB3 信号传导无关
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 饲养条件和小鼠品系显着影响代谢表型，影响临床前研究的转化相关性。尽管 C57BL/6J (C57) 小鼠被广泛使用，但它们的产热和肾上腺素能特征可能无法完全反映人类生理学。本研究比较了雄性 C57 和 C3H/HeJ (C3H) 小鼠对寒冷暴露的产热反应。将动物安置在 Promethion 间接量热系统中并暴露于不同的环境温度。光照阶段的热中性点几乎相同（C57：29.26±0.28°C；C3H：29.46±0.17°C），但C3H小鼠在急性和慢性冷暴露期间表现出显着更高的能量消耗（EE）。基因表达分析显示，C3H 小鼠的棕色脂肪组织 (BAT) 中产热基因的诱导作用更强。值得注意的是，C3H 小鼠的 BAT 和白色脂肪组织 (WAT) 中 β3 肾上腺素受体 ( Adrb3 ) 的表达极少，并且不受冷暴露的影响。与受损的 β3 信号传导一致，β3 激动剂 CL 316,243 显着增加了 C57 小鼠的 EE，但对 C3H 小鼠的影响有限。相比之下，去甲肾上腺素在两种品系中均引发 EE 反应，而普萘洛尔预处理（一种 β1/β2 拮抗剂）消除了这些品系差异，表明 C3H 小鼠依赖于 β1/β2 或非经典途径。总之，C3H 小鼠通过 ADRB3 独立机制表现出增强的冷诱导生热作用。尽管热中性点相似，C3H 和 C57 小鼠表现出不同的代谢和肾上腺素能适应，强调了代谢研究中菌株选择的重要性。 C3H 小鼠可能代表研究适用于人类生理学的替代生热机制的模型。

data.title: Platelet-rich plasma promotes cellular recovery from nicotine-induced toxicity via autophagy modulation
data.author: Julie Vérièpe-Salerno, José Antonio Cancela, Solange Vischer, Antoine Turzi, Muriel Cuendet, Catherine Giannopoulou, Sarah Berndt
data.summary: Abstract Chronic exposure to nicotine significantly exacerbates periodontitis, a prevalent inflammatory disease, by inducing cellular processes such as autophagy and inflammation in gingival fibroblasts. Current therapies often fail to fully address these cellular alterations in smokers, highlighting a need for innovative therapeutic and regenerative approaches. This study explores the therapeutic potential of Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), a blood-derived product, to modulate nicotine-induced biological activities in primary gingival fibroblasts, particularly in the case of periodontitis in smokers. Gingival fibroblasts were treated with increasing concentrations of nicotine, which led to senescence and autophagy. Nicotine at high concentrations triggered cellular vacuolization, and a decrease in metabolism, viability and proliferation. Concomitant cell treatment with 10% PRP reversed nicotine effects and significantly increased cell migration potential. In Caenorhabditis elegans, PRP reduced the nicotine-induced autophagic activity. A screening of the gingival fibroblast secretome revealed a modulation of autophagy-related cytokines in response to nicotine and/or PRP. The findings demonstrate that PRP could effectively inhibit nicotine-induced autophagy in gingival fibroblasts, offering insights into its possible use as a therapeutic tool for managing periodontitis in smokers. The study underscores the potential of PRP in altering disease progression by modulating key cellular processes affected by smoking.
data.title_cn: 富含血小板的血浆通过自噬调节促进细胞从尼古丁诱导的毒性中恢复
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 长期接触尼古丁会诱导牙龈成纤维细胞自噬和炎症等细胞过程，从而显着加剧牙周炎（一种常见的炎症性疾病）。目前的疗法往往无法完全解决吸烟者的这些细胞改变，这凸显了对创新治疗和再生方法的需求。本研究探讨了富含血小板血浆（PRP）（一种血液衍生产品）调节尼古丁诱导的初级牙龈成纤维细胞生物活性的治疗潜力，特别是在吸烟者的牙周炎情况下。用增加浓度的尼古丁处理牙龈成纤维细胞，导致衰老和自噬。高浓度的尼古丁会引发细胞空泡化，并降低新陈代谢、活力和增殖。同时用 10% PRP 进行细胞处理可逆转尼古丁效应并显着增加细胞迁移潜力。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，PRP 降低了尼古丁诱导的自噬活性。对牙龈成纤维细胞分泌组的筛选揭示了尼古丁和/或 PRP 对自噬相关细胞因子的调节作用。研究结果表明，PRP 可以有效抑制尼古丁诱导的牙龈成纤维细胞自噬，为其作为治疗吸烟者牙周炎的治疗工具提供了见解。该研究强调了 PRP 通过调节受吸烟影响的关键细胞过程来改变疾病进展的潜力。

data.title: Building user trust in AI chatbots for customer service through human-like cues and perceived reliability
data.author: Sheng Wang, Noor Fatima, Muhammad Shahbaz, Muhammad Asif
data.summary: This qualitative study explores how human-like cues and system competence shape users’ trust and perceptions of reliability in AI-driven chatbot customer service. Data were collected from 28 participants through semi-structured interviews conducted in Pakistan and China. Using thematic analysis supported by NVivo 15, the study identifies key patterns in the formation of user trust and interaction experiences. Two main themes emerged: human-like interaction and emotional connection, and perceived reliability and system competence. The first highlights conversational naturalness, empathy, personalisation, and social presence as drivers of affective trust. In contrast, the second emphasises accuracy, transparency, responsiveness, and data security as core elements of cognitive trust. Together, these dimensions illustrate how emotional and functional factors jointly influence user confidence and satisfaction with chatbots. Beyond reaffirming established trust constructs, the study offers context-specific qualitative insights that deepen understanding of how users in a developing market interpret and negotiate trust in AI-mediated service interactions.
data.title_cn: 通过类人提示和感知可靠性，建立用户对人工智能聊天机器人的客户服务信任
data.abstract_cn: 这项定性研究探讨了类人线索和系统能力如何塑造用户对人工智能驱动的聊天机器人客户服务的信任和可靠性感知。通过在巴基斯坦和中国进行的半结构化访谈收集了 28 名参与者的数据。该研究利用 NVivo 15 支持的主题分析，确定了用户信任和交互体验形成的关键模式。出现了两个主题：类人交互和情感联系，以及感知可靠性和系统能力。第一个强调对话的自然性、同理心、个性化和社会存在感作为情感信任的驱动力。相比之下，第二个强调准确性、透明度、响应性和数据安全性作为认知信任的核心要素。这些维度共同说明了情感和功能因素如何共同影响用户对聊天机器人的信心和满意度。除了重申已建立的信任结构之外，该研究还提供了针对具体情况的定性见解，加深了对发展中市场中的用户如何解释和协商人工智能介导的服务交互中的信任的理解。

data.title: Enhancement of yield and fruit quality of strawberry under deficit fertigation via sodium hydrosulfide and L-cysteine
data.author: Anmar Mohammed Abdulazeez, Hamid Hassanpour, Karim Manda-Hakki
data.summary: Strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa) is a high-value crop whose yield and fruit quality are extremely susceptible to water and nutrient limitations, especially in greenhouse and soilless cultivation. Developing strategies to maintain productivity under reduced fertigation is therefore crucial. This study investigated whether applying sulfur-related compounds, specifically sodium hydrosulfide (NaHS) and L-cysteine (Cys), to the strawberry cv. Sabrina could counteract the detrimental effects of reduced nutrient supply. Plants were treated with NaHS (500 and 1000 µM) or Cys (500 and 1000 µM) under two fertigation levels (100 mL and 140 mL as control). Applying reduced fertigation alone resulted in physiological constraints, whereas NaHS and Cys significantly increased yield, improved fruit quality traits, and enhanced antioxidant capacity compared with untreated plants. Also, activities of phenylalanine ammonia lyase, catalase, and ascorbate peroxidase were significantly increased. The improvements were associated with higher levels of phenolics, anthocyanins, and vitamin C, indicating a coordinated strengthening of the enzymatic and non-enzymatic defense systems. Overall, foliar applications of 1000 µM NaHS and 1000 µM Cys under reduced fertigation schedules were most effective in improving strawberry productivity and fruit quality. This study highlights the potential of sulfur-based elicitors as practical, eco-friendly tools to improve stress tolerance, preserve nutritional value, and optimize water and nutrient use in controlled cultivation systems.
data.title_cn: 硫氢化钠和L-半胱氨酸提高赤字施肥条件下草莓的产量和果实品质
data.abstract_cn: 草莓（Fragaria × ananassa）是一种高价值作物，其产量和果实品质极易受到水和养分限制的影响，特别是在温室和无土栽培中。因此，制定在减少灌溉施肥条件下保持生产力的策略至关重要。本研究调查了是否将硫相关化合物，特别是硫氢化钠 (NaHS) 和 L-半胱氨酸 (Cys) 应用于草莓品种。塞布丽娜可以抵消营养供应减少的不利影响。在两种灌溉施肥水平（100 mL 和 140 mL 作为对照）下用 NaHS（500 和 1000 µM）或 Cys（500 和 1000 µM）处理植物。单独减少灌溉施肥会导致生理限制，而与未经处理的植物相比，NaHS和Cys显着提高了产量，改善了果实品质性状，并增强了抗氧化能力。此外，苯丙氨酸解氨酶、过氧化氢酶和抗坏血酸过氧化物酶的活性显着增加。这些改善与较高水平的酚类、花青素和维生素 C 相关，表明酶促和非酶促防御系统的协调增强。总体而言，在减少灌溉施肥计划的情况下叶面喷施 1000 µM NaHS 和 1000 µM Cys 对于提高草莓生产力和果实品质最为有效。这项研究强调了硫基诱导子作为实用、环保工具的潜力，可提高受控栽培系统中的抗逆性、保持营养价值以及优化水和养分的利用。

data.title: Leveraging molecular descriptors and explainable machine learning for monomer conversion prediction in photoinduced electron transfer-reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer polymerization
data.author: Berna Alemdag, Azra Kocaarslan, Gözde Kabay
data.summary: This study presents a molecular descriptor-based machine learning (ML) architecture for predicting monomer conversion in photoinduced electron transfer-reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer (PET-RAFT) polymerization systems. Unlike traditional polymer informatics approaches that treat polymers as single units or use one-hot encoding for reaction components, we decompose each PET-RAFT system into its individual parts: monomer, RAFT agent, and photocatalyst. Next, each element was separately encoded using 2D molecular descriptors derived from SMILES. Using a literature-sourced dataset of 152 PET-RAFT systems, we systematically trained (with fivefold cross-validation, CV) and evaluated 10 ML algorithms. CatBoost showed greater stability across CV-folds (SD = ± 0.07) and was identified as the top performer for monomer conversion prediction (R2 = 0.84; RMSE = 10.04 pps; MAE = 8.16 pps). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis revealed mechanistically interpretable structure–property-performance relationships, highlighting that monomer topological complexity, electronic polarization, and molecular weight together account for over 60% of the model’s predictive power. External validation confirmed CatBoost’s ability to generalize to unseen (meth)acrylates and (meth)acrylamides (MAE = 8.03), with comparable performance to that of the training set. In practice, the learned descriptor-conversion mapping enables fast in silico screening and component ranking, highlighting actionable descriptor ranges and potentially accelerating design-build-test cycles for high-conversion PET-RAFT.
data.title_cn: 利用分子描述符和可解释的机器学习来预测光诱导电子转移-可逆加成-断裂链转移聚合中的单体转化率
data.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种基于分子描述符的机器学习（ML）架构，用于预测光诱导电子转移-可逆加成-断裂链转移（PET-RAFT）聚合系统中的单体转化。与将聚合物视为单个单元或对反应组分使用单热编码的传统聚合物信息学方法不同，我们将每个 PET-RAFT 系统分解为单独的部分：单体、RAFT 试剂和光催化剂。接下来，使用源自 SMILES 的 2D 分子描述符单独编码每个元素。使用 152 个 PET-RAFT 系统的文献来源数据集，我们系统地训练（通过五重交叉验证，CV）并评估了 10 种 ML 算法。 CatBoost 在 CV 倍数上表现出更高的稳定性 (SD = ± 0.07)，并被确定为单体转化预测的最佳表现者 (R2 = 0.84；RMSE = 10.04 pps；MAE = 8.16 pps)。 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 分析揭示了机械上可解释的结构-性能-性能关系，强调单体拓扑复杂性、电子极化和分子量共同占模型预测能力的 60% 以上。外部验证证实了 CatBoost 能够泛化到看不见的（甲基）丙烯酸酯和（甲基）丙烯酰胺 (MAE = 8.03)，其性能与训练集相当。在实践中，学习到的描述符转换映射可以实现快速的计算机筛选和组件排序，突出显示可操作的描述符范围，并有可能加速高转换 PET-RAFT 的设计-构建-测试周期。

data.title: Evaluation of deep learning models for segmentation of hippocampus volumes from MRI images in Alzheimer’s disease
data.author: Yori Pusparani, Chih-Yang Lin, Yih-Kuen Jan, Ben-Yi Liau, Fu-Yu Lin, Elvin Nur Furqon, Muhammad Talal, Sheena Christabel Pravin, Zhi-Ren Tsai, Chi-Wen Lung
data.summary: The hippocampus is a crucial brain structure associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Precise segmentation is crucial for studying AD progression using deep learning. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of deep learning models in segmenting the left and right hippocampus in MRI images. We hypothesized that deep learning-based approaches would enable precise and accurate segmentation of the left and right hippocampus. We propose U-Net, You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLO-v8), and DeepLab-v3 models using the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset. This study used 300 subjects, comprising 100 subjects (AD), 100 subjects with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 100 subjects with normal control (NC), resulting in a total of 7859 image slices. The results showed that the U-Net model exhibited the best Intersection over Union (IoU), which served as a key performance indicator among the three classes: AD (0.639), MCI (0.801), and NC (0.751). In contrast, YOLO-v8 demonstrated lower IoU performance for AD (0.342), MCI (0.465), and NC (0.550), which are considered inappropriate models to segment the left and right hippocampus. We obtained the left hippocampus volume of AD (1557.5 mm³), MCI (1863.3 mm3), and NC (2089.2 mm3). The right hippocampus volumes of AD (1593.4 mm³), MCI (1918.7 mm3), and NC (2280.2 mm3). The U-Net model exhibited the best performance. We expect deep learning-based methods to assist in clinical decisions by providing accurate hippocampus segmentation.
data.title_cn: 评估阿尔茨海默病 MRI 图像中海马体体积分割的深度学习模型
data.abstract_cn: 海马体是与阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 相关的重要大脑结构。精确分割对于使用深度学习研究 AD 进展至关重要。本研究旨在评估深度学习模型在分割 MRI 图像中左右海马体方面的性能。我们假设基于深度学习的方法可以实现左右海马体的精确分割。我们提出使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像计划 (ADNI) 数据集的 U-Net、You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLO-v8) 和 DeepLab-v3 模型。这项研究使用了 300 名受试者，其中包括 100 名受试者 (AD)、100 名轻度认知障碍 (MCI) 受试者和 100 名正常对照 (NC) 受试者，总共产生 7859 个图像切片。结果表明，U-Net 模型表现出最好的交并集 (IoU)，它是 AD (0.639)、MCI (0.801) 和 NC (0.751) 三个类别中的关键性能指标。相比之下，YOLO-v8 在 AD (0.342)、MCI (0.465) 和 NC (0.550) 方面表现出较低的 IoU 性能，这些模型被认为不适合分割左右海马。我们获得了 AD (1557.5 mm3)、MCI (1863.3 mm3) 和 NC (2089.2 mm3) 的左侧海马体积。 AD (1593.4 mm3)、MCI (1918.7 mm3) 和 NC (2280.2 mm3) 的右侧海马体积。 U-Net模型表现出最好的性能。我们期望基于深度学习的方法通过提供准确的海马体分割来协助临床决策。

data.title: Ursodeoxycholic acid alleviates α-Casein-induced cow’s milk protein allergy via the TGR5/NF-κB signaling pathway
data.author: Zhidan Yu, Zihui Wang, Lingling Yue, Yuesheng Wang, Bo Sun, Ruifeng Wang, Xiangzhan Zhu, Lifeng Li, Wancun Zhang, Xiaoqin Li
data.summary: Cow’s milk protein allergy (CMPA), one of the most common food allergies in infant, is primarily manifesting gastrointestinal symptoms and closely associated to the disorders of gut microbiota. Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA), a gut microbiota derived secondary bile acid, is significantly decreased in infant with CMPA. However, the effect and mechanism of UDCA in colitis of CMPA is unknown. Our analysis demonstrated that UDCA administration alleviated the systemic allergic symptoms, improved body weight gain, and mitigated histopathological damage in both liver and colon tissues in a mouse model of α-Casein-induced CMPA. UDCA restored intestinal barrier integrity by increasing goblet cell numbers and enhancing the expression of the tight junction gene in colonic tissue. In α-Casein-sensitized RAW264.7 cells, UDCA promoted the healing and migration. Additionally, UDCA significantly down-regulated the secretion and mRNA levels of key pro-inflammatory factors (IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6) and the production of inflammatory mediators (NO, ROS). Mechanistically, UDCA increased the cAMP level and up-regulated G-protein coupled receptors (TGR5) expression and inhibited the NF-κB signaling pathway, as evidenced by reduced phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of p65 in vivo and in vitro. Pharmacological antagonism with SBI-115 confirmed that UDCA suppressed α-Casein-induced NF-κB p65 activation primarily by targeting TGR5. This study suggested that UDCA may alleviate CMPA by targeting TGR5 to enhance intestinal barrier function and modulate immune response via NF-κB signaling, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic strategy for allergic diseases.
data.title_cn: 熊去氧胆酸通过 TGR5/NF-κB 信号通路减轻 α-酪蛋白诱导的牛奶蛋白过敏
data.abstract_cn: 牛奶蛋白过敏（CMPA）是婴儿最常见的食物过敏之一，主要表现为胃肠道症状，与肠道菌群失调密切相关。熊去氧胆酸 (UDCA) 是一种肠道微生物群衍生的次级胆汁酸，在患有 CMPA 的婴儿中显着减少。然而，UDCA在CMPA结肠炎中的作用和机制尚不清楚。我们的分析表明，在 α-酪蛋白诱导的 CMPA 小鼠模型中，UDCA 给药可减轻全身过敏症状，改善体重增加，并减轻肝脏和结肠组织的组织病理学损伤。 UDCA 通过增加杯状细胞数量和增强结肠组织中紧密连接基因的表达来恢复肠道屏障的完整性。在α-酪蛋白致敏的RAW264.7细胞中，UDCA促进愈合和迁移。此外，UDCA 显着下调关键促炎因子（IL-1β、TNF-α、IL-6）的分泌和 mRNA 水平以及炎症介质（NO、ROS）的产生。从机制上讲，UDCA 增加 cAMP 水平，上调 G 蛋白偶联受体 (TGR5) 表达，并抑制 NF-κB 信号通路，体内和体外 p65 磷酸化和核转位的减少证明了这一点。 SBI-115 的药理学拮抗作用证实 UDCA 主要通过靶向 TGR5 来抑制 α-酪蛋白诱导的 NF-κB p65 激活。这项研究表明，UDCA 可能通过靶向 TGR5 来增强肠道屏障功能并通过 NF-κB 信号调节免疫反应来缓解 CMPA，凸显了其作为过敏性疾病治疗策略的潜力。

data.title: High-performance scene classification in remote sensing imagery using a custom deep CNN architecture
data.author: Ahmed M. Abdelmonem, Mohamed Maher Ata, Abdelhamied A. Atey, A. A. Shaalan, Rania A. El-Sayed
data.summary: Abstract This research presents a deep novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture specifically designed for multi-class image categorization in remote sensing data. The proposed model is evaluated using both the NWPU-RESISC45 and UC Merced Land Use datasets, each containing 10 class categories: harbor, chaparral, tennis court, industrial area, parking lot, forest, beach, overpass, airplane, and baseball diamond. Extensive testing demonstrates that the proposed CNN architecture outperforms five popular pre-trained CNN models in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Quantitative results show that the proposed model achieves an accuracy of 0.9428 on the NWPU-RESISC45 dataset and 0.93 on the UC Merced dataset. The recall scores are 0.94 and 0.93, while precision values reach 0.95 and 0.94, respectively. Furthermore, the Intersection over Union (IoU) scores are 0.89 and 0.86, while the F1-scores are 0.94 and 0.93, confirming the robustness of the model across the datasets. In terms of computational efficiency, the model demonstrates competitive training times: 3,692 s for NWPU-RESISC45 (5,057 images across 10 classes) with GPU memory usage of 12.7 gigabytes (GB) and 559 s for the UC Merced dataset (722 images across 10 classes ). To ensure and enhance the interpretability and explainability of the model’s predictions, two interpretability techniques were incorporated: Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) and Class Activation Mapping (CAM). The key novelties of this manuscript include: a hybrid CNN framework that not only advances classification performance but also incorporates explainability via SHAP and CAM, while maintaining efficient training times and strong generalization, making it a compelling solution for remote sensing image understanding. In general, the key novel aspects of our approach are: Lightweight and efficient architecture: Our proposed CNN design strikes a balance between performance and computational efficiency, making it highly suitable for real-time or resource-constrained environments without compromising accuracy. Integrated interpretability: By incorporating both SHAP (Shapley Additive explanations) and CAM (Class Activation Mapping), our framework delivers strong predictive performance. Generalizability across datasets: We demonstrate the model’s robustness and generalizability across two challenging and diverse datasets, confirming its adaptability to different domain scenarios.
data.title_cn: 使用定制深度 CNN 架构对遥感图像进行高性能场景分类
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：本研究提出了一种深度新颖的卷积神经网络（CNN）架构，专为遥感数据中的多类图像分类而设计。所提出的模型使用 NWPU-RESISC45 和 UC Merced 土地利用数据集进行评估，每个数据集包含 10 个类别：港口、丛林、网球场、工业区、停车场、森林、海滩、立交桥、飞机和棒球场。广泛的测试表明，所提出的 CNN 架构在准确性和效率方面优于五种流行的预训练 CNN 模型。定量结果表明，该模型在 NWPU-RESISC45 数据集上的准确率达到 0.9428，在 UC Merced 数据集上的准确率达到 0.93。召回率分别为 0.94 和 0.93，准确率分别达到 0.95 和 0.94。此外，交并集 (IoU) 分数为 0.89 和 0.86，而 F1 分数为 0.94 和 0.93，证实了模型在数据集中的稳健性。在计算效率方面，该模型展示了具有竞争力的训练时间：NWPU-RESISC45 的训练时间为 3,692 秒（跨 10 个类别的 5,057 张图像），GPU 内存使用量为 12.7 GB；UC Merced 数据集的训练时间为 559 秒（跨 10 个类别的 722 张图像）。为了确保和增强模型预测的可解释性和可解释性，引入了两种可解释性技术：Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) 和 Class Activation Mapping (CAM)。该手稿的主要新颖之处包括：混合 CNN 框架，不仅可以提高分类性能，还可以通过 SHAP 和 CAM 实现可解释性，同时保持高效的训练时间和强大的泛化能力，使其成为遥感图像理解的一个引人注目的解决方案。总的来说，我们的方法的关键新颖之处是： 轻量级和高效的架构：我们提出的 CNN 设计在性能和计算效率之间取得了平衡，使其非常适合实时或资源受限的环境，而不会影响准确性。集成的可解释性：通过结合 SHAP（沙普利附加解释）和 CAM（类激活映射），我们的框架提供了强大的预测性能。跨数据集的通用性：我们在两个具有挑战性和多样化的数据集上展示了模型的稳健性和通用性，确认了其对不同领域场景的适应性。

data.title: The structural, mechanical, electrical, and radiation-shielding properties of newly yttrium and neodymium-doped lithium-zinc-phosphate glasses
data.author: Gharam A. Alharshan, Shaaban M. Shaaban, R.A. Elsad, A.A. Demewez, Mohamed Elsafi
data.summary: This paper investigates novel yttrium-doped lithium-zinc-phosphate glass prepared via melt-quenching and characterizes their electrical, mechanical, shielding, structural, and physical properties, with a focus on the impact of varying yttrium concentrations on these aspects. The heavier Y2O3 gradually replaces the lighter P2O5 units, increasing density from 3.0265 g.cm− 3 towards 3.136 g.cm− 3. The FTIR results clearly show that the addition of Y2O3 alters its phosphate glass structures by introducing Y–O bonds, producing non-bridging oxygens, and upsetting the P–O–P network. With rising frequency, relative permittivity decreases rapidly at low frequencies and becomes semi-constant at high frequencies. In general, the relative permittivity and ac conductivity rose in tandem with the Y2O3 quantity. The replacing improved the mechanical and radiation shielding characteristics of the glass, since the Young’s modulus improved from 72.688 GPa to 74.663 GPa. The exposure buildup factor (EBF) was calculated at different mfp’s. At very low energies (such as 0.015 MeV), the EBF values ​​are very close to 1 and increased with raising the energy. It was found that some slight improvement in the radiation absorption performance of the prepared glasses with higher yttrium content.
data.title_cn: 新型掺钇和掺钕锂锌磷酸盐玻璃的结构、机械、电学和辐射屏蔽性能
data.abstract_cn: 本文研究了通过熔融淬火制备的新型掺钇锂锌磷酸盐玻璃，并表征了其电气、机械、屏蔽、结构和物理性能，重点关注不同钇浓度对这些方面的影响。较重的 Y2O3 逐渐取代较轻的 P2O5 单元，密度从 3.0265 g.cm− 3 增加到 3.136 g.cm− 3。FTIR 结果清楚地表明，Y2O3 的添加通过引入 Y-O 键、产生非桥接氧和扰乱 P-O-P 网络来改变其磷酸盐玻璃结构。随着频率的升高，相对介电常数在低频下迅速下降，在高频下变为半常数。一般来说，相对介电常数和交流电导率随 Y2O3 数量的增加而增加。由于杨氏模量从 72.688 GPa 提高到 74.663 GPa，更换后的玻璃的机械和辐射屏蔽特性得到了改善。曝光累积因子 (EBF) 是在不同的 mfp 下计算的。在非常低的能量（如0.015 MeV）下，EBF值非常接近1，并且随着能量的提高而增加。结果发现，所制备的钇含量较高的玻璃的辐射吸收性能略有改善。

data.title: Functional imaging of time on task and the involvement of dopaminergic and cholinergic substrates in cognitive effort and reward
data.author: Chiara Orsini, Julia E. Bosch, Karin Labek, Roberto Viviani
data.summary: Neuroimaging studies have identified the neural substrates associated with sustained cognitive efforts and control and their modulation by rewards. Different lines of evidence implicate the prefrontal cortex (especially the anterior cingulate cortex, ACC), dopaminergic, and cholinergic substrates in this modulation. We studied here the activity of these substrates at increasing time on task (requiring increasing levels of cognitive effort) in trials within blocks with differing reward levels. In the cortex, while peaking in the ACC, activity associated with time on task was extensive, also including activity decrements outside the default mode network, primarily involving motor and somatosensory regions. Information about reward levels was carried in the ventral striatum, consistent with its motivational role, but did not reflect trade-offs with increasing efforts during time on task. Instead, the ventral tegmental area and parts of the basal forebrain (BF) corresponding to the cholinergic Ch4 nuclei increased in activity with time on task and were sensitive to reward levels. This BF activity is consistent with a cholinergic role in driving compensatory efforts modulated by reward levels. These findings identify the BF as a neuroimaging phenotype associated with sustaining task sets and cognitive efforts.
data.title_cn: 任务时间的功能成像以及多巴胺能和胆碱能底物在认知努力和奖励中的参与
data.abstract_cn: 神经影像学研究已经确定了与持续认知努力和控制及其通过奖励的调节相关的神经基质。不同的证据表明前额叶皮层（特别是前扣带皮层，ACC）、多巴胺能和胆碱能底物参与了这种调节。我们在这里研究了在具有不同奖励水平的区块内的试验中，随着任务时间的增加（需要增加认知努力水平）这些底物的活性。在皮质中，虽然 ACC 达到峰值，但与任务时间相关的活动非常广泛，还包括默认模式网络之外的活动减少，主要涉及运动和体感区域。有关奖励水平的信息由腹侧纹状体携带，与其激励作用一致，但并未反映在任务期间增加努力的权衡。相反，与胆碱能 Ch4 核相对应的腹侧被盖区和基底前脑 (BF) 部分的活动随着任务时间的延长而增加，并且对奖励水平敏感。这种 BF 活动与驱动由奖励水平调节的补偿努力的胆碱能作用一致。这些发现将 BF 确定为与维持任务集和认知努力相关的神经影像表型。

data.title: Integrated virtual screening, ADMET profiling, and molecular dynamics simulations of novel natural HDAC6 inhibitors with the potential to ameliorate skeletal muscle degeneration
data.author: Khurshid Ahmad, Syed Sayeed Ahmad, Inho Choi
data.summary: Histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) helps maintain muscle health and regulates protein balance. In atrophic muscle, increased HDAC6 activity destabilizes microtubules and intensifies protein degradation. Therefore, selective HDAC6 inhibition is a promising approach to preserving muscle health. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive computational analysis, including virtual screening of 449,058 natural compounds from the SuperNatural 3.0 database, to identify novel natural HDAC6 inhibitors. The top candidates were filtered for drug-likeness and ADMET properties, then subjected to molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations (MDS) to evaluate binding stability and energy profiles. The 20 best-scoring compounds (range of LibDock score: 120.54 to 167.81) were visually analyzed for their docking poses, and top-ranked compounds, SN0000021 and SN0000043, were selected for evaluation. Two natural compounds, SN0000021 and SN0000043, consistently showed strong predicted binding, favorable pharmacokinetic features, and stable interaction with the HDAC6 catalytic pocket throughout a 200-ns MDS. SN0000021 has moderate solubility, high Caco-2 permeability, and ~ 93% intestinal absorption, while SN0000043 shows slightly higher solubility, moderate permeability, and ~ 75% absorption. Both are AMES non-toxic and synthetically accessible. Free-energy calculations further confirmed their binding potential. These results indicate that SN0000021 and SN0000043 are plausible natural scaffolds for the development of selective HDAC6 inhibitors. Experimental validation in HDAC6 enzyme assays and SM models is required to confirm their anti-atrophic effects.
data.title_cn: 对具有改善骨骼肌退化潜力的新型天然 HDAC6 抑制剂进行集成虚拟筛选、ADMET 分析和分子动力学模拟
data.abstract_cn: 组蛋白脱乙酰酶 6 (HDAC6) 有助于维持肌肉健康并调节蛋白质平衡。在萎缩的肌肉中，HDAC6 活性增加会破坏微管的稳定性并加剧蛋白质降解。因此，选择性 HDAC6 抑制是保持肌肉健康的一种有前途的方法。在这项研究中，我们进行了全面的计算分析，包括对 SuperNatural 3.0 数据库中的 449,058 种天然化合物进行虚拟筛选，以鉴定新型天然 HDAC6 抑制剂。对最佳候选药物进行药物相似性和 ADMET 特性筛选，然后进行分子对接和分子动力学模拟 (MDS)，以评估结合稳定性和能量分布。对 20 个得分最高的化合物（LibDock 得分范围：120.54 至 167.81）的对接姿势进行了视觉分析，并选择排名最高的化合物 SN0000021 和 SN0000043 进行评估。两种天然化合物 SN0000021 和 SN0000043 在整个 200 ns MDS 中始终表现出强烈的预测结合、良好的药代动力学特征以及与 HDAC6 催化袋的稳定相互作用。 SN0000021 具有中等溶解度、高 Caco-2 渗透性和约 93% 的肠道吸收，而 SN0000043 显示稍高的溶解度、中等渗透性和约 75% 的吸收。两者均是 AMES 无毒且可合成。自由能计算进一步证实了它们的结合潜力。这些结果表明SN0000021和SN0000043是用于开发选择性HDAC6抑制剂的合理的天然支架。需要在 HDAC6 酶测定和 SM 模型中进行实验验证，以确认其抗萎缩作用。

data.title: Autofluorescence and Fourier transform infrared analyses trace dietary fluorophores and reveal plastic contamination in the gut of mosquito larvae
data.author: Sara Soldano, Maduka L. Weththimuni, Amanda Oldani, Alessandro Girella, Andrea Moyano, Anna C. Croce, Maurizio Licchelli, Ludvik M. Gomulski, Francesca Scolari
data.summary: Understanding the nutritional physiology of mosquito larvae is crucial for optimizing mass-rearing practices and improving control strategies. Here we combined complementary optical and spectroscopic techniques, including fluorescence microscopy, confocal spectral imaging and Attenuated Total Reflectance (ATR) Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, to trace food ingestion in Aedes albopictus larvae. Differences in autofluorescence (AF) signal intensity and spatial distribution were observed in the gut of larvae reared in polystyrene (PS) or glass (GL) containers, suggesting that AF may serve as a relative proxy for evaluating ingestion efficiency. Chlorophyll-derived AF was detected outside the gut within the larval body, indicating systemic distribution of food-derived fluorophores. Spectral analysis of rearing water before and after larval development revealed changes in flavin-associated fluorescence profiles, consistent with flavin metabolism. Moreover, ATR-FTIR spectroscopy of larval gut samples revealed differences in chemical functional groups between larvae reared in PS or GL containers, suggesting ingestion of PS-derived material released from rearing containers. Despite the spectroscopic differences observed between rearing conditions, no clear effects were detected on standard mosquito life-history traits. Taken together, these findings highlight the potential of fluorescence- and ATR-FTIR-based techniques as sensitive tools to explore mosquito larval biology and nutrition. These approaches can reveal subtle yet biologically relevant effects of the rearing environment, a key factor in vector control programmes.
data.title_cn: 自发荧光和傅里叶变换红外分析追踪膳食荧光团并揭示蚊子幼虫肠道中的塑料污染
data.abstract_cn: 了解蚊子幼虫的营养生理学对于优化大规模饲养实践和改进控制策略至关重要。在这里，我们结合了互补的光学和光谱技术，包括荧光显微镜、共焦光谱成像和衰减全反射（ATR）傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱，来追踪白纹伊蚊幼虫的食物摄入情况。在聚苯乙烯（PS）或玻璃（GL）容器中饲养的幼虫肠道中观察到自发荧光（AF）信号强度和空间分布的差异，表明AF可以作为评估摄入效率的相对指标。在幼虫体内的肠道外检测到叶绿素衍生的 AF，表明食物衍生的荧光团的全身分布。对幼体发育前后饲养水的光谱分析揭示了黄素相关荧光谱的变化，这与黄素代谢一致。此外，幼虫肠道样本的 ATR-FTIR 光谱揭示了在 PS 或 GL 容器中饲养的幼虫之间化学官能团的差异，表明摄入了从饲养容器中释放的 PS 衍生物质。尽管在饲养条件之间观察到光谱差异，但没有检测到对标准蚊子生活史特征的明显影响。总而言之，这些发现凸显了基于荧光和 ATR-FTIR 的技术作为探索蚊子幼虫生物学和营养的敏感工具的潜力。这些方法可以揭示饲养环境的微妙但与生物学相关的影响，这是病媒控制计划的关键因素。

data.title: Video-dominant emotion recognition for portable EEG-based devices
data.author: Xinyi Wen, Wei Xu, Lei Tian, Cuijuan Guo, Jinjun Bai
data.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals offer a promising avenue for detecting emotional responses during video viewing, enabling the automated recognition of video-induced emotions and providing an objective assessment approach. However, current approaches face two main limitations. First, emotion labels often rely on subjective self-reports that introduce personal bias. Second, most systems require high-density electrode arrays that are costly and impractical for portable applications. To address these challenges, this study explores video emotion recognition using a lightweight EEG setup. We introduce three complementary strategies: (i) a dynamic hierarchical label calibration approach that reduces labeling subjectivity through consistency modeling and boundary refinement; (ii) a multi-dimensional energy ratio analysis that compresses channel requirements while preserving discriminative information; and (iii) a saliency-guided feature selection method to improve generalization capability. By reducing 65% of the channels from the original dataset, our approach achieves 45% accuracy in four-class dominant video emotion prediction using only 11 channels, while maintaining meaningful discriminative performance under cross-subject conditions. Beyond technical advancements, these results demonstrate the potential of EEG-based systems to capture collective emotional responses to video content. This capability supports practical applications in audience sentiment analysis, media content evaluation, and emotion-aware recommendation systems.
data.title_cn: 基于视频的便携式脑电图设备的情绪识别
data.abstract_cn: 脑电图 (EEG) 信号为检测视频观看期间的情绪反应提供了一种有前景的途径，从而能够自动识别视频引发的情绪并提供客观的评估方法。然而，当前的方法面临两个主要限制。首先，情绪标签通常依赖于引入个人偏见的主观自我报告。其次，大多数系统需要高密度电极阵列，这对于便携式应用来说成本高昂且不切实际。为了应对这些挑战，本研究探索使用轻量级脑电图设置进行视频情感识别。我们引入了三种互补策略：（i）动态分层标签校准方法，通过一致性建模和边界细化减少标签主观性； (ii) 多维能量比分析，在保留区分信息的同时压缩信道需求； (iii) 显着性引导的特征选择方法以提高泛化能力。通过从原始数据集中减少 65% 的通道，我们的方法仅使用 11 个通道即可在四类主导视频情感预测中实现 45% 的准确率，同时在跨主题条件下保持有意义的判别性能。除了技术进步之外，这些结果还证明了基于脑电图的系统在捕捉对视频内容的集体情绪反应方面的潜力。该功能支持受众情绪分析、媒体内容评估和情感感知推荐系统的实际应用。

data.title: An innovative power converter based technique for on-site photovoltaic I-V characterization under natural irradiance
data.author: Mohammed Rhiat, Firyal Latrache, Mustapha Melhaoui, Ilias Atmane, Imane Ihsane, Mostafa El Ouariachi, Kamal Hirech, Mourad Yessef, Z. M.S. El-Barbary, Saad A. Alqahtani, Badre Bossoufi
data.summary: This paper presents a standalone PV curve tracer designed to extract current-voltage (I-V) and power-voltage (P-V) characteristics, as well as the five parameters of a Multiple-Diode Model (MDM) with identical diodes, effectively reducing it to a single-diode model for parameter extraction, under real sunlight conditions. The system consists of a custom-built synchronous boost converter operating as a programmable electronic load, where the duty cycle of the PWM signal regulates the equivalent resistance. Integrated with voltage and current sensors, along with external solar irradiance and temperature sensors, the system enables the automatic extraction of I-V and P-V curves for PV panels up to 300 W. Experiments were conducted on a 12-cell ET-M53630WW PV panel (VOC = 21.52 V, ISC = 1.8 A, VMP = 17.72 V, IMP = 1.69 A and PMP = 30 W), demonstrating the system’s performance under realistic operating conditions. A nonlinear least squares fitting algorithm based on the Levenberg-Marquardt method processes the extracted curves to determine the five key parameters of the PV panel with high precision. Experimental validation demonstrated that the estimated and measured I-V curves are nearly identical, with a worst-case current deviation of only 41.5 mA. The reconstructed P-V curve at standard test conditions (G = 1000 W/m², T = 298.15 K) closely matched the manufacturer’s datasheet, yielding a maximum power of 27 W compared to the rated 30 W. These results highlight the accuracy of the proposed methodology in parameter extraction and its potential application in PV performance monitoring, degradation analysis, and educational use.
data.title_cn: 基于创新功率转换器的技术，用于自然辐照度下的现场光伏 I-V 表征
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种独立的 PV 曲线追踪器，旨在提取电流-电压 (I-V) 和功率-电压 (P-V) 特性，以及具有相同二极管的多二极管模型 (MDM) 的五个参数，有效地将其简化为单二极管模型，以便在真实阳光条件下进行参数提取。该系统由一个作为可编程电子负载运行的定制同步升压转换器组成，其中 PWM 信号的占空比可调节等效电阻。该系统与电压和电流传感器以及外部太阳辐照度和温度传感器集成，可自动提取功率高达 300 W 的光伏电池板的 I-V 和 P-V 曲线。实验在 12 节电池 ET-M53630WW 光伏电池板（VOC = 21.52 V、ISC = 1.8 A、VMP = 17.72 V、IMP = 1.69 A 和 PMP = 30）上进行。 W），展示了系统在实际操作条件下的性能。基于Levenberg-Marquardt方法的非线性最小二乘拟合算法处理提取的曲线，以高精度确定光伏电池板的五个关键参数。实验验证表明，估计和测量的 I-V 曲线几乎相同，最坏情况下的电流偏差仅为 41.5 mA。在标准测试条件（G = 1000 W/m²，T = 298.15 K）下重建的 P-V 曲线与制造商的数据表非常匹配，与额定 30 W 相比，产生的最大功率为 27 W。这些结果突出了所提出的参数提取方法的准确性及其在光伏性能监测、退化分析和教育用途中的潜在应用。

data.title: Land surface phenometrics and their responses to climatic variables in the semi-arid rangelands of the central Zagros mountains
data.author: Fatemeh Pordel, Reza Jafari, Mostafa Tarkesh Esfahani, Mohsen Ahmadi, Geoffrey M. Henebry, Ataollah Ebrahimi, Adrià Descals, Josep Penuelas
data.summary: As climate change accelerates, phenological shifts in vulnerable semi-arid ecosystems remain poorly understood yet are of increasingly critical. Identifying the phenological stages of rangeland ecosystems, and quantifying how climate change affects each stage over time, is essential for effective rangeland management. This study aimed to investigate the long-term trends in land surface phenology (LSP) and the impact of climate variations on LSP in the semi-arid rangelands of Chaharmahal-Va-Bakhtiari (CVB) Province, Iran, from 2000 to 2023. Utilizing satellite data from MODIS NDVI, key LSP metrics were analyzed, including the start of the growing season (SOS), peak of the growing season (POS), end of the growing season (EOS), length of the growing season (LOS), and maximum vegetation greenness (maxNDVI). The findings indicate significant shifts: SOS, POS and EOS are occurring earlier, resulting in shorter growing season in many regions. These changes show strong correlations with climatic variables such as precipitation, temperature, and potential evapotranspiration, with temperature exhibiting the most significant relationship to changes in SOS. The Sen’s slope trend analysis showed that 25.74% of the study area experienced advancements in SOS, 23.2% % in POS, and 32.3% in EOS. Additionally, LOS has decreased in 70% of pixels with significant change. This study demonstrates that phenological patterns in the semi-arid rangelands of CVB are shifting in response to climate change. These findings highlight the need to implement adaptive management strategies to maintain the sustainability of these fragile ecosystems.
data.title_cn: 扎格罗斯山脉中部半干旱牧场的地表现象测定及其对气候变量的响应
data.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化的加速，人们对脆弱的半干旱生态系统的物候变化仍知之甚少，但其重要性却日益凸显。确定牧场生态系统的物候阶段，并量化气候变化如何随时间影响每个阶段，对于有效的牧场管理至关重要。本研究旨在调查 2000 年至 2023 年伊朗 Chaharmahal-Va-Bakhtiari (CVB) 省半干旱牧场地表物候 (LSP) 的长期趋势以及气候变化对 LSP 的影响。利用 MODIS NDVI 卫星数据，分析了关键的 LSP 指标，包括生长季开始 (SOS)、生长季高峰 (POS)、生长季结束。 (EOS)、生长季长度 (LOS) 和最大植被绿度 (maxNDVI)。研究结果表明了重大变化：SOS、POS 和 EOS 发生得更早，导致许多地区的生长季节缩短。这些变化与降水、温度和潜在蒸散量等气候变量有很强的相关性，其中温度与 SOS 的变化关系最为显着。 Sen 斜率趋势分析显示，25.74% 的研究区域在 SOS 方面取得了进步，23.2% 在 POS 方面取得了进步，在 EOS 方面取得了 32.3% 的进步。此外，70% 的像素的 LOS 有所下降，且变化显着。这项研究表明，CVB 半干旱牧场的物候模式正在因气候变化而发生变化。这些发现强调需要实施适应性管理策略以维持这些脆弱生态系统的可持续性。

data.title: Exploration of electrospinning hemp/polyacrylonitrile composite fiber membrane and dye adsorption capabilities
data.author: Ying Sun, Jiayi Wang, Weishuai Kong, Yucan Jia
data.summary: Textile printing and dyeing wastewater has complex water quality and causes great harm. As a common pollutant, the cationic methylene blue dye is harmful to health. Therefore, adsorption technology plays a crucial role in wastewater treatment. To study the application of hemp/polyacrylonitrile nanocomposite fiber membranes in dye adsorption, this study employed electrospinning technology. This study used electrospinning to prepare hemp/polyacrylonitrile nanocomposite fiber membranes for dye adsorption. Hemp fibers were dissolved in LiCl/DMAc, blended with polyacrylonitrile solution, and electrospun after single-factor optimization. The results show that the hemp/polyacrylonitrile composite fiber membrane has a uniform diameter distribution, good hydrophilicity, and excellent mechanical and physical properties. The particulate matter filtration test reveals that the membrane’s filtration efficiency can reach 99.97%. The adsorption of methylene blue by the hemp/polyacrylonitrile composite fiber membrane is more consistent with the pseudo-second-order kinetic model and the Langmuir adsorption isotherm model, indicating that it is mainly dominated by chemical adsorption. The adsorption process is a spontaneous endothermic reaction, and a higher temperature is more conducive to adsorption, with an adsorption capacity of up to 75.85 mg/g. The simple method yielded membranes with excellent dye adsorption and particulate filtration performance.
data.title_cn: 静电纺大麻/聚丙烯腈复合纤维膜及染料吸附能力探讨
data.abstract_cn: 纺织印染废水水质复杂，危害极大。阳离子亚甲蓝染料作为一种常见污染物，对健康有害。因此，吸附技术在废水处理中起着至关重要的作用。为了研究大麻/聚丙烯腈纳米复合纤维膜在染料吸附中的应用，本研究采用静电纺丝技术。本研究采用静电纺丝法制备用于染料吸附的大麻/聚丙烯腈纳米复合纤维膜。将大麻纤维溶解在LiCl/DMAc中，与聚丙烯腈溶液共混，经过单因素优化后进行静电纺丝。结果表明，大麻/聚丙烯腈复合纤维膜直径分布均匀，亲水性良好，具有优异的机械物理性能。颗粒物过滤测试表明，该膜的过滤效率可达99.97%。大麻/聚丙烯腈复合纤维膜对亚甲基蓝的吸附更符合准二级动力学模型和Langmuir吸附等温线模型，表明其主要以化学吸附为主。吸附过程是自发吸热反应，温度越高越有利于吸附，吸附量可达75.85 mg/g。这种简单的方法产生了具有优异的染料吸附和颗粒过滤性能的膜。

data.title: MM-GradCAM: an improved multimodal GradCAM method with 1D and 2D ECG data for detection of cardiac arrhythmia
data.author: Fatma Murat Duranay, Ender Murat, Özal Yıldırım, Yakup Demir, Ru-San Tan, Niranjana Sampathila, U. Rajendra Acharya
data.summary: Abstract As cardiac arrhythmia remains one of the leading causes of death worldwide, early and accurate diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmia is critical to improving patient outcomes. Electrocardiogram (ECG) analysis plays a critical role in the diagnosis of these diseases, and recent advances in deep learning have led to significant advances in automated ECG interpretation. However, the “black box” nature of these models limits clinical confidence and highlights the need for explainable artificial intelligence methods. This study presents an innovative MM-GradCAM method that combines two different data formats, providing explainability for both 1D ECG signal and 2D ECG image data. Using a dataset of more than 10,000 patients, a 17-layer CNN model capable of four-class arrhythmia detection was developed and separate explainability outputs were obtained for each data form. The resulting explainability maps were evaluated by a cardiologist and the interpretability and clinical significance of the model were verified. The signal form achieved 93.07% accuracy, while the image form achieved 97.44% accuracy. As a pioneering approach for explainability in medical diagnosis, MM-GradCAM has the potential to increase reliability and transparency in medical AI applications.
data.title_cn: MM-GradCAM：一种改进的多模式 GradCAM 方法，具有 1D 和 2D ECG 数据，用于检测心律失常
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 由于心律失常仍然是全世界死亡的主要原因之一，心律失常的早期、准确诊断对于改善患者的预后至关重要。心电图 (ECG) 分析在这些疾病的诊断中发挥着至关重要的作用，深度学习的最新进展导致自动心电图解读方面取得了重大进展。然而，这些模型的“黑匣子”性质限制了临床信心，并凸显了对可解释的人工智能方法的需求。本研究提出了一种创新的 MM-GradCAM 方法，该方法结合了两种不同的数据格式，为 1D ECG 信号和 2D ECG 图像数据提供了可解释性。使用超过 10,000 名患者的数据集，开发了能够进行四级心律失常检测的 17 层 CNN 模型，并为每种数据形式获得了单独的可解释性输出。心脏病专家对所得的可解释性图进行了评估，并验证了模型的可解释性和临床意义。信号形式的准确率达到93.07%，图像形式的准确率达到97.44%。作为医疗诊断可解释性的开创性方法，MM-GradCAM 有潜力提高医疗 AI 应用的可靠性和透明度。

data.title: Integrative single-cell and machine learning framework reveals prognostic fibroblast subtypes and constructs a fibroblast-related risk signature in lung adenocarcinoma
data.author: Shizhao Cheng, Han Zhang, Qiuqiao Mu, Hao Zhang, Lin Tan, Daqiang Sun
data.summary: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is a major subtype of non-small cell lung cancer and continues to contribute substantially to global cancer mortality. Within the tumor ecosystem, cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are key stromal components that significantly influence LUAD progression. However, their phenotypic diversity and clinical implications remain incompletely elucidated. We integrated two single-cell RNA sequencing datasets (GSE171145 and GSE189357) to delineate the transcriptional landscape and developmental trajectory of fibroblasts in LUAD. A fibroblast-related signature (FRS) was developed by intersecting fibroblast-specific markers with differentially expressed genes from the TCGA-LUAD cohort, followed by univariate Cox analysis and machine learning modeling. A total of 101 combinations of ten machine learning algorithms were evaluated. The prognostic value of the FRS was validated across multiple GEO datasets. We further investigated its associations with immune infiltration, genomic alterations, and therapeutic response. The core gene TIMP1 was subjected to in vitro and clinical validation. We identified pronounced fibroblast heterogeneity in LUAD, with distinct differentiation trajectories revealed by pseudotime analysis. The constructed FRS exhibited robust prognostic performance across cohorts and was significantly correlated with immunosuppressive features, tumor mutation burden, and predicted immunotherapy outcomes. Clinically, the FRS served as an independent prognostic indicator and showed favorable calibration when combined with TNM stage in a nomogram. TIMP1, one of the top-ranked risk genes in univariate Cox analysis, was confirmed to be upregulated in tumor samples and to promote cell invasion and proliferation in vitro, supporting its functional role in LUAD progression. This study developed a fibroblast-based prognostic signature through integrative single-cell and bulk transcriptomic analyses. The FRS effectively stratifies LUAD patients and highlights the dynamic roles of fibroblasts in shaping tumor progression, providing potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
data.title_cn: 集成的单细胞和机器学习框架揭示了预后成纤维细胞亚型并构建了肺腺癌中成纤维细胞相关的风险特征
data.abstract_cn: 肺腺癌（LUAD）是非小细胞肺癌的主要亚型，并且继续对全球癌症死亡率产生重大影响。在肿瘤生态系统中，癌症相关成纤维细胞 (CAF) 是显着影响 LUAD 进展的关键基质成分。然而，它们的表型多样性和临床意义仍未完全阐明。我们整合了两个单细胞 RNA 测序数据集（GSE171145 和 GSE189357）来描绘 LUAD 中成纤维细胞的转录景观和发育轨迹。通过将成纤维细胞特异性标记物与 TCGA-LUAD 队列中的差异表达基因交叉，然后进行单变量 Cox 分析和机器学习建模，开发了成纤维细胞相关特征 (FRS)。总共评估了 10 种机器学习算法的 101 种组合。 FRS 的预后价值在多个 GEO 数据集上得到了验证。我们进一步研究了它与免疫浸润、基因组改变和治疗反应的关联。核心基因TIMP1经过体外和临床验证。我们在 LUAD 中发现了明显的成纤维细胞异质性，通过伪时间分析揭示了不同的分化轨迹。构建的 FRS 在各队列中表现出强大的预后性能，并且与免疫抑制特征、肿瘤突变负担和预测的免疫治疗结果显着相关。临床上，FRS 作为独立的预后指标，与列线图中的 TNM 分期结合时显示出良好的校准效果。 TIMP1 是单变量 Cox 分析中排名最高的风险基因之一，被证实在肿瘤样本中表达上调，并在体外促进细胞侵袭和增殖，支持其在 LUAD 进展中的功能作用。这项研究通过综合单细胞和批量转录组分析开发了基于成纤维细胞的预后特征。 FRS 有效对 LUAD 患者进行分层，并强调成纤维细胞在塑造肿瘤进展中的动态作用，提供潜在的生物标志物和治疗靶点。

data.title: Investigating the influence of expanded perlite and lime mud on cement-bonded composites containing pulp sludge
data.author: Stephen O. Amiandamhen, Carsten Mai, Joran van Blokland, Geoffrey Daniel, Stergios Adamopoulos
data.summary: Abstract This paper presents a comprehensive study on lightweight cement-bonded composites containing pulp sludge (PS). The objective of the study was to evaluate how the incorporation of perlite (a lightweight volcanic glass aggregate) and lime mud (a pulp mill residue) influences composites’ properties including mechanical strength, insulation and fire resistance. Up to 50% of the cement binder was replaced with PS (by mass), and small fractions of cement (5–15%) were replaced with perlite or lime mud. A suite of analytical techniques, material characterization and mechanical tests with digital image correlation (DIC) for strain analysis were employed. X-ray analysis showed that the aggregates influenced the composite properties to a considerable extent due to their particle sizes and ability to form hydrated gels with cement. Adding 5% of perlite or lime mud yields optimal strength without compromising weight reduction whereas higher aggregate content (15%) led to reduced strength. The DIC system provided insights into strain distribution during loading, confirming enhanced toughness from the fibrous PS. The composites were significantly lighter (732–749 kg/m 3 ) and showed about 30% lower thermal conductivity (0.17 W/mK) than pure cement composites (0.25 W/mK). The normal incidence sound absorption of the composites was about 0.3 at mid-high frequencies due to their compact structure. The composites demonstrated potential for use as sustainable, lightweight construction materials with good acoustic and thermal insulation, as well as acceptable load-bearing capacity for non-structural applications based on EN 634-1/-2 requirements for cement-bonded particleboards.
data.title_cn: 研究膨胀珍珠岩和石灰泥对含纸浆污泥的水泥粘结复合材料的影响
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 本文对含有纸浆污泥（PS）的轻质水泥复合材料进行了综合研究。该研究的目的是评估珍珠岩（一种轻质火山玻璃骨料）和石灰泥（一种纸浆厂残渣）的结合如何影响复合材料的性能，包括机械强度、绝缘性和耐火性。高达 50% 的水泥粘结剂被 PS 替代（按质量计），小部分水泥 (5-15%) 被珍珠岩或石灰泥替代。采用了一套分析技术、材料表征和机械测试以及用于应变分析的数字图像相关 (DIC)。 X 射线分析表明，骨料由于其粒径和与水泥形成水合凝胶的能力，在很大程度上影响了复合材料的性能。添加 5% 的珍珠岩或石灰泥可在不影响重量减轻的情况下产生最佳强度，而较高的骨料含量 (15%) 会导致强度降低。 DIC 系统提供了对加载过程中应变分布的深入了解，证实了纤维 PS 的韧性增强。该复合材料明显更轻（732-749 kg/m 3 ），并且导热系数（0.17 W/mK）比纯水泥复合材料（0.25 W/mK）低约30%。由于其结构致密，复合材料的中高频法向入射吸声率约为0.3。该复合材料显示出作为可持续、轻质建筑材料的潜力，具有良好的隔音和隔热性能，以及基于 EN 634-1/-2 对水泥粘合刨花板的要求的非结构应用可接受的承载能力。

data.title: Effects of silicon carbide nanoparticles on mechanical and vibrational characteristics of carbon glass epoxy hybrid composites
data.author: K. S. Suhas, Vamsi Krishna Reddy, Yeturi Thirumanas Reddy, Yogeesha Pai
data.summary: Abstract This study presents an experimental investigation into the mechanical, vibrational, and acoustic properties of carbon/glass fibre-reinforced epoxy hybrid laminates embedded with varying weight percentages of silicon carbide (SiC) nanoparticles. The laminates were fabricated using compression moulding, with a six-layer alternating stacking sequence of carbon and glass fibres. A comprehensive series of tests was conducted to assess flexural strength, tensile behaviour, impact resistance, free-vibration characteristics, and sound-absorption performance. Mechanical tests revealed that the laminate with 3 wt% SiC achieved the highest tensile strength of 258.8 MPa, flexural strength of 292.6 MPa, Young’s modulus of 19.13 GPa, and impact strength of 67.9 kJ/m 2 , indicating optimal reinforcement and efficient stress transfer due to uniform nanoparticle dispersion. These values correspond to improvements of approximately 19.05%, 15.22%, 15.37%, and 7.65%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced (0 wt%) composite. SEM analysis substantiated the improved fibre–matrix interaction and the minimal microstructural defects at the optimal filler content. Conversely, the 5 wt% SiC specimens exhibited reduced mechanical performance, attributed to particle agglomeration and weakened interfacial bonding. Vibration analysis indicated a peak in stiffness and natural frequency at 3 wt% SiC, while damping behaviour declined with increasing filler loading. Acoustic testing showed enhanced transmission loss with increasing SiC content, with 5 wt% yielding the best sound-attenuation performance. The study concludes that incorporating SiC nanoparticles into carbon/glass hybrid composites significantly improves their multifunctional performance when the filler content is optimized, with the 3 wt% SiC composition offering the best balance between strength, stiffness, and acoustic efficiency.This advances SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure) by developing resilient, lightweight composites for sustainable aerospace/transport infrastructure, reducing emissions via efficiency gains.
data.title_cn: 碳化硅纳米颗粒对碳玻璃环氧杂化复合材料机械和振动特性的影响
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：本研究对嵌入不同重量百分比的碳化硅 (SiC) 纳米颗粒的碳/玻璃纤维增​​强环氧混合层压板的机械、振动和声学性能进行了实验研究。层压板采用压缩成型工艺制造，采用碳纤维和玻璃纤维的六层交替堆叠顺序。进行了一系列全面的测试，以评估弯曲强度、拉伸性能、抗冲击性、自由振动特性和吸音性能。机械测试表明，含有 3 wt% SiC 的层压板达到了最高的拉伸强度 258.8 MPa、弯曲强度 292.6 MPa、杨氏模量 19.13 GPa 和冲击强度 67.9 kJ/m 2 ，表明由于均匀的纳米颗粒分散而实现了最佳的增强和有效的应力传递。与未增强（0 wt%）复合材料相比，这些值分别对应于约 19.05%、15.22%、15.37% 和 7.65% 的改进。 SEM 分析证实了最佳填料含量下纤维-基体相互作用的改善和微观结构缺陷的最小化。相反，5 wt% SiC 样品表现出机械性能下降，这归因于颗粒团聚和界面结合减弱。振动分析表明，SiC 含量为 3 wt% 时，刚度和固有频率达到峰值，而阻尼性能则随着填料用量的增加而下降。声学测试表明，随着 SiC 含量的增加，传输损耗也会增加，其中 5 wt% 可产生最佳的声音衰减性能。研究得出的结论是，当填料含量优化时，将 SiC 纳米颗粒纳入碳/玻璃混合复合材料中可显着提高其多功能性能，其中 3 wt% 的 SiC 成分可在强度、刚度和声学效率之间实现最佳平衡。通过开发用于可持续航空航天/运输基础设施的弹性轻质复合材料，通过提高效率减少排放，从而推进 SDG 9（工业、创新和基础设施）。

data.title: High-capacity and secure inter-satellite optical wireless communication using 2D DPS-OCDMA
data.author: Ammar Armghan, Somia A. Abd El-Mottaleb, Sultan S. Aldkeelalah, Slim Chaoui, Ahmed Emara, Mehtab Singh
data.summary: Inter-satellite optical wireless communication (IsOWC) has emerged as a promising technology for high-capacity and secure links in next-generation satellite networks. The overall system efficiency, however, is highly dependent on several design factors, including the receiver aperture size, pointing error, optical efficiency, and additional propagation losses, which must be carefully addressed to ensure reliable operation over long inter-satellite distances. This paper proposes an enhanced IsOWC model that employs two-dimensional optical code division multiple access (2D-OCDMA) based on diagonal permutation shift (DPS) codes to enhance link capacity while maintaining secure transmission. The proposed system is assessed under diverse channel scenarios by altering the inter-satellite link (ISL), the diameter of the receiving aperture, pointing inaccuracies, optical transmission efficiency. System performance is evaluated using metrics including bit error rate (BER), Q-factor, and visual inspection. The results demonstrate that the adoption of 2D-OCDMA significantly improves transmission quality, achieving reliable communication over ranges up to 16,000 km. Furthermore, using 2D DPS code provides inherent security, since data can only be decoded by receivers equipped with the proper code sequence. Additionally, the proposed system supports an overall data rate of 120 Gbps with BER values well below the forward error correction (FEC) threshold (3.8 × 10−3) under realistic conditions.
data.title_cn: 使用 2D DPS-OCDMA 的高容量、安全的星间光无线通信
data.abstract_cn: 卫星间光无线通信 (IsOWC) 已成为下一代卫星网络中高容量和安全链路的一项有前景的技术。然而，整体系统效率高度依赖于几个设计因素，包括接收器孔径尺寸、指向误差、光学效率和额外传播损耗，必须仔细解决这些因素，以确保在长距离卫星间可靠运行。本文提出了一种增强的 IsOWC 模型，该模型采用基于对角置换移位 (DPS) 码的二维光码分多址 (2D-OCDMA) 来增强链路容量，同时保持安全传输。通过改变卫星间链路（ISL）、接收孔径直径、指向误差、光传输效率，在不同的信道场景下对所提出的系统进行评估。使用误码率 (BER)、Q 因子和目视检查等指标来评估系统性能。结果表明，采用2D-OCDMA显着提高了传输质量，实现了长达16,000公里的可靠通信。此外，使用 2D DPS 代码提供了固有的安全性，因为数据只能由配备适当代码序列的接收器解码。此外，所提出的系统支持 120 Gbps 的总体数据速率，在实际条件下，BER 值远低于前向纠错 (FEC) 阈值 (3.8 × 10−3)。

data.title: Enhanced seed quality and physio-biochemical parameters in lentil through biochar and humic acid- based seed priming
data.author: Sumit Chauhan, Karthik Bhardwaj, Deepak Rao, Narender Pal, Rajneesh Kumar, Ajaz Ahmed Lone, Mehdi Rahimi
data.summary: Lentil (Lens culinaris Medik.) is a nutritionally valuable pulse crop that enhances food security and soil fertility through biological nitrogen fixation. However, its productivity is often constrained by poor germination and uneven seedling establishment. This study investigated biochar and humic acid as sustainable seed-priming agents to improve lentil seed performance. After preliminary optimization, the most effective concentrations of both agents were evaluated under controlled laboratory conditions. Germination percentage, seedling length, vigour indices, chlorophyll content, and oxidative stress response (DAB assay) were assessed. Both treatments significantly enhanced seed and seedling traits compared with unprimed controls (p < 0.05). Biochar priming increased germination by 14.7%, seedling length by 26.3%, and vigour index by 32.5% over control, alongside higher chlorophyll content and reduced hydrogen peroxide accumulation, indicating improved physiological efficiency and stress mitigation. Humic acid also improved performance, though to a lesser degree. The results demonstrate that biochar and humic acid priming enhance seed vigour and metabolic activity by promoting stress regulation and efficient energy utilization. Overall, biochar emerged as the superior and eco-friendly option for improving germination and early growth in lentil, offering a practical approach for sustainable pulse production and climate-resilient agriculture.
data.title_cn: 通过生物炭和腐殖酸种子引发提高扁豆的种子质量和生理生化参数
data.abstract_cn: 小扁豆 (Lens culinaris Medik.) 是一种营养价值很高的豆类作物，可通过生物固氮提高粮食安全和土壤肥力。然而，其生产力往往受到发芽不良和幼苗生长不均匀的限制。这项研究调查了生物炭和腐殖酸作为可持续的种子引发剂来改善扁豆种子的性能。经过初步优化后，在受控实验室条件下评估了两种药物的最有效浓度。评估发芽率、幼苗长度、活力指数、叶绿素含量和氧化应激反应（DAB 测定）。与未处理的对照相比，两种处理均显着增强了种子和幼苗的性状（p < 0.05）。与对照相比，生物炭引发使发芽率提高了 14.7%，幼苗长度提高了 26.3%，活力指数提高了 32.5%，同时叶绿素含量更高，过氧化氢积累减少，表明生理效率和胁迫缓解得到改善。腐植酸也提高了性能，但程度较小。结果表明，生物炭和腐植酸引发剂通过促进应激调节和有效的能量利用来增强种子活力和代谢活性。总体而言，生物炭成为改善扁豆发芽和早期生长的优质且环保的选择，为可持续豆类生产和气候适应型农业提供了实用方法。

data.title: Evaluating the RUNOFF01 model’s performance and potential for micro-catchment design
data.author: Ali Shabani, Artemis Roodari, Ali Reza Sepaskhah
data.summary: This study evaluates the performance of the RUNOFF01 model for simulating Hortonian overland flow under conditions where the entire watershed contributes to runoff, rendering scale effects negligible. The model was validated against three distinct datasets: (1) rainfall simulator experiments on a loam soil with various surface treatments (gravel, corrugations, and chemical amendments), (2) flume experiments on sandy loam and silty clay soils under different slopes and rainfall intensities, and (3) data from a 4.83-hectare agricultural catchment. Statistical analysis, using normalized root mean square error (NRMSE < 0.2), index of agreement (d > 0.96), and F-tests, demonstrated strong agreement between simulated and measured runoff across all scenarios. The results confirm that for slope lengths under ~ 350 m and extended rainfall duration—common in arid-region micro-catchments—the time to equilibrium (tₑ) is rapidly achieved, and the model accurately predicts runoff volume using key inputs like rainfall intensity, infiltration rate, and slope. The RUNOFF01 model can be used as a reliable tool for designing water harvesting systems and soil conservation strategies in ungauged agricultural basins.
data.title_cn: 评估 RUNOFF01 模型的性能和微流域设计潜力
data.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了 RUNOFF01 模型在整个流域都会产生径流、规模效应可以忽略不计的情况下模拟霍顿地表径流的性能。该模型针对三个不同的数据集进行了验证：(1) 在经过各种表面处理（砾石、波纹和化学改良剂）的壤土上进行的降雨模拟器实验，(2) 在不同坡度和降雨强度下对砂壤土和粉质粘土进行的水槽实验，以及 (3) 来自 4.83 公顷农业流域的数据。使用归一化均方根误差 (NRMSE < 0.2)、一致性指数 (d > 0.96) 和 F 检验进行的统计分析表明，所有情景中的模拟径流和测量径流之间具有很强的一致性。结果证实，对于小于 350 m 的坡长和延长的降雨持续时间（在干旱地区微流域中常见），可以快速达到平衡时间 (tₑ)，并且该模型使用降雨强度、入渗率和坡度等关键输入准确预测径流量。 RUNOFF01 模型可用作设计未计量农业流域的集水系统和土壤保持策略的可靠工具。
